versions.changelog: Sync existing infra403/opentwitter-2 from https://github.com/6551Team/opentwitter-mcp, main commit 8d69ca5e856f2026fde6b1903f6e06d63bab0770, directory openclaw-skill/opentwitter. Replace outdated SKILL.md with current upstream Twitter/X and meme evidence documentation; package.json remains byte-identical. Exact upstream source files only, excluding generated skill-card.md. Preserve display name Opentwitter, owner and slug. No examples executed.

- Initial release of the opentwitter skill for accessing Twitter/X data via the 6551 API.
- Supports user profile lookup (by username or user ID).
- Enables searching tweets with flexible filters (keywords, hashtags, users, language, date range).
- Retrieve recent tweets, deleted tweets, follower events (follows/unfollows), and KOL followers.
- Requires a Bearer token in the $TWITTER_TOKEN environment variable for all API requests.
